attested_fields.communication_plan: Recovery status is published to the #incident-bridge channel and a stakeholder status page from a single incident-commander source of truth
attested_fields.stakeholder_matrix: exec sponsor, legal, comms, affected business owners, and the impacted customer's TAM are notified per the RACI in the DR runbook
attested_fields.update_cadence: internal updates every 30m and external updates every 4h until recovery is declared complete
